desc4: The equipper's CRIT DMG increases by 20%. When any character in the squad triggers <color=#FE437E>Corruption</color> DMG, this effect further increases by 5.5% for 8s, stacking up to 6 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
name: Chaotic Metal
story: A Drive Disc burned with specialized Ether technology offering personalized attribute amplification to the user.
